reviewer_note: Hand review of Gemini's post-fix held-out answers against the article text (docs/evaluation.md section 18). Judgement calls, recorded so they can be checked.

supported_by_article.why: SQuAD marks a question unanswerable for one paragraph; another part of the article answers it.

sidestepped_false_premise.why: States true facts from the article that contradict or avoid the question's false premise, or says the year is not given, without claiming the asked-for fact.

fell_for_trap.why: The question was altered (negation, swapped word) so the text no longer answers it; the answer responds as if it did.
